live-change.schema.json.title: AmberX AXF live change (live-change@1)
live-change.schema.json.description: Generated from framework/core/engines/live-rows.ts (spec/LIVE-CHANGES.md). One change to one row of one keyed, ordered row set; revs are contiguous per namespace.

live-change-batch.schema.json.title: AmberX AXF live change batch and resync (live-change-batch@1, live-change-resync@1)
live-change-batch.schema.json.description: Generated from framework/core/engines/live-rows.ts (spec/LIVE-CHANGES.md). What a store answers to since(ns, rev): a batch of contiguous events, or the whole row set when the consumer must resync.

errors: a live change is an object
ns: a data-store namespace, optionally /<path>, at most 160 chars
key: 1–128 chars, no /
op: one of upsert | delete | reorder
rev: an integer ≥ 1
origin: { session, surface } required
ts: ms since the epoch, an integer ≥ 0
$axf must be live-change@1
ns: a data-store namespace, optionally /<path>, at most 160 chars
key: 1–128 chars, no /
op: one of upsert | delete | reorder
rev: an integer ≥ 1
epoch: a string of at most 64 chars
origin.session: 1–64 chars
origin.surface: a lower-case word (console, cli, mcp, voice, api, orchestrator, hub, plugin, server, …)
origin.client: a string of at most 64 chars
origin.opId: a string of at most 64 chars
ts: ms since the epoch, an integer ≥ 0
row: required with upsert, the whole row as an object
row: only with upsert
before: required with reorder, a key or null
before: only with reorder

rev-not-last: rev 99 is not the last event's rev 6
foreign-ns: events[0]: ns differs from the batch
bad-event: events[0]: key: 1–128 chars, no /; op: one of upsert | delete | reorder; rev: an integer ≥ 1; origin: { session, surface } required; ts: ms since the epoch, an integer ≥ 0
